The '''Starhunter''' was a further evolution of the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that saw use with the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the latter stages of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Boasting more firepower, with heavy weapons in addition to [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], the Starhunter also carried a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] generator. It was operated by a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

==History==
Starhunters first saw widespread use during the closing weeks of the war, particularly during the [[Second Battle of Roche]] and the [[Battle of Uroro Station]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The naming convention for the Starhunter is unclear; the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'' refers to it as simply "Starhunter"; however, it does state quite clearly that it is an evolution of the TIE Interceptor.
